generalized_learning.generalized_failure_pattern: A specialized contract can be correct while a canonical current-state source still describes the same capability as future, pending, or unavailable.
generalized_learning.plausible_wrong_implementation: Update the implementation-facing document and pass link checks without scanning canonical status sources for obsolete state claims.
trigger_signals: capability changes from future to operational
specialized contract changes status or availability
generalized_learning.reusable_control: DOC-STATE-DRIFT-001: when capability state changes, scan canonical current-state sources and historical scope documents, classify every old-state occurrence, and require zero unresolved current contradictions.
generalized_learning.prevention_rule: A state-changing delivery must update every canonical current-state source in the same material candidate, not only specialized documentation.
generalized_learning.detection_rule: Before handoff, search old and new state terms across canonical status surfaces and classify matches as current, historical, compatibility, or contradiction; unresolved current contradictions block readiness.

transfer_cases.surface: canonical status matrix versus specialized capability contract
transfer_cases.evidence: Synthetic current-state claim is rejected when specialized contract marks the capability operational.

transfer_cases.surface: product roadmap versus historical execution plan
transfer_cases.evidence: Synthetic historical out-of-scope text remains allowed while an obsolete current roadmap statement is rejected.

skill_changes.evidence: Delivery now records canonical state sources and unresolved contradictions in documentation-impact before freeze.
DOC-STATE-DRIFT-001 is added to cumulative inherited controls and must pass on the final material head.
